hadiths.arabicText: فِي الْجُنُبِ يَغْتَسِلُ وَلَا يَنْوِي الْجَنَابَةَ

hadiths.english_translation: Malik said: Whoever experiences major ritual impurity (janabah) and bathes for Friday prayer without intending the bath for janabah, or bathes due to heat without intending the bath for janabah, or bathes in any manner without intending the bath for janabah - that does not suffice him from the bath of janabah. He said: It is like a man who prays a voluntary prayer, and it does not suffice him from an obligatory prayer. Malik said: If he performs ablution intending voluntary prayer, or recitation of the Quran, or intending the purity of prayer, that suffices him. Malik said: If he performs ablution due to heat he feels, or the like, and does not intend ablution for what I mentioned to you, it does not suffice him from ablution for prayer, nor from touching the Quran, nor voluntary prayer and the like. Ibn al-Qasim said: Ablution according to Malik is not valid except with intention. I said: If he performs ablution and his feet remain, then he wades through a river, or wipes his feet with his hands in the water, except that he intends by his wading the washing of his feet? He said: This does not suffice him. Ibn Wahb said: Abdul-Jabbar ibn Umar informed me, from Rabi'ah, that he said: If a man enters a river and bathes in it without performing the bath of janabah, that does not suffice him until he intends by the bath the bath of janabah, and if he prays I see that he should repeat the prayer. Ibn Wahb said: And it reached me from Ali ibn Abi Talib that he said: 'That does not purify him until he remembers his bath from janabah.' Ibn Wahb said: Malik and al-Layth ibn Sa'd said likewise. And Malik said: Verily, deeds are by intentions.

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ : وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ : مَنْ أَصَابَتْهُ جَنَابَةٌ ، فَاغْتَسَلَ لِلْجُمُعَةِ وَلَمْ يَنْوِ بِهِ غُسْلَ الْجَنَابَةِ ، أَوِ اغْتَسَلَ مِنْ حَرٍّ يَجِدُهُ لَا يَنْوِي بِهِ غُسْلَ الْجَنَابَةِ ، أَوِ اغْتَسَلَ عَلَى أَيْ وَجْهٍ كَانَ مَا لَمْ يَنْوِ بِهِ غُسْلَ الْجَنَابَةِ لَمْ يُجْزِهِ ذَلِكَ مِنْ غُسْلِ الْجَنَابَةِ , قَالَ : وَهُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ رَجُلٍ صَلَّى نَافِلَةً ، فَلَا تُجْزِئُهُ مِنْ فَرِيضَةٍ , قَالَ مَالِكٌ : وَإِنْ تَوَضَّأَ يُرِيدُ صَلَاةَ نَافِلَةٍ ، أَوْ قِرَاءَةَ مُصْحَفٍ ، أَوْ يُرِيدُ بِهِ طُهْرَ صَلَاةٍ ، فَذَلِكَ يُجْزِئُهُ , قَالَ مَالِكٌ : وَإِنْ تَوَضَّأَ مِنْ حَرٍّ يَجِدُهُ ، أَوْ نَحْوِ ذَلِكَ ، وَلَا يَنْوِي الْوُضُوءُ لِمَا ذَكَرْتُ لَكَ ، فَلَا يُجْزِئُهُ مِنْ وُضُوءٍ لِلصَّلَاةِ ، وَلَا مِنْ مَسِّ الْمُصْحَفِ وَلَا النَّافِلَةِ وَنَحْوِهِ . قَالَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ : لَا يَكُونُ الْوُضُوءُ عندَ مَالِكٍ إِلَّا بِنِيَّةٍ . قُلْتُ : فَإِنْ تَوَضَّأَ وَبَقِيَ رِجْلَاهُ ، فَخَاضَ نَهْرًا ، أَوْ مَسَحَ بِيَدَيْهِ رِجْلَيْهِ فِي الْمَاءِ إِلَّا أَنَّهُ يَنْوِي بِتَخْوِيضِهِ غَسْلَ رِجْلَيْهِ ؟ قَالَ : لَا يُجْزِئُهُ هَذَا . قَالَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ : قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْجَبَّارِ بْنُ عُمَرَ ، عن رَبِيعَةَ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلًا دَخَلَ نَهْرًا ، فَاغْتَسَلَ فِيهِ وَلَا يَعْمَلُ غُسْلَ الْجَنَابَةِ لَمْ يُجْزِ ذَلِكَ عنهُ حَتَّى يَعْمِدَ بِالْغُسْلِ غُسْلَ الْجَنَابَةِ ، وَإِنْ صَلَّى أَرَى أَنْ يُعِيدَ الصَّلَاةَ . قَالَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ : وَبَلَغَنِي عن /93 عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ /93 ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : "   لَا يُطَهِّرُهُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يَذْكُرَ غُسْلَهُ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ " قَالَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ : وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ ، وَاللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ مِثْلَهُ , وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ : وَإِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّةِ .

hadiths.english_translation: Malik said: Zayd ibn Aslam said: There is no harm in a person in a state of janabah passing through the mosque as a traveler (passing through). He said: And Zayd used to interpret this verse regarding that: 'nor in a state of janabah except as travelers passing through' [Quran 4:43], and he used to be lenient in that. Malik said: I do not like for one in a state of janabah to enter the mosque as a traveler passing through, nor otherwise, and I see no harm in one who is without ablution passing through it and sitting in it.

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ : وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ قَالَ زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ : لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ يَمُرَّ الْجُنُبُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ عَابِرَ سَبِيلٍ , قَالَ :    @ 1 : 81 @   وَكَانَ زَيْدٌ يَتَأَوَّلُ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ فِي ذَلِكَ /4 وَلَا جُنُبًا إِلَّا عَابِرِي سَبِيلٍ /4 ، وَكَانَ يُوَسِّعُ فِي ذَلِكَ , قَالَ مَالِكٌ : وَلَا يُعْجِبَنِي أَنْ يَدْخُلَ الْجُنُبُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ عَابِرَ سَبِيلٍ ، وَلَا غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ ، وَلَا أَرَى بَأْسًا أَنْ يَمُرَّ فِيهِ مَنْ كَانَ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ وَيَقْعُدَ فِيهِ .

hadiths.arabicText: فِي اغْتِسَالِ النَّصْرَانِيَّةِ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ وَالْحَيْضَةِ

hadiths.english_translation: Malik said: A Muslim man does not force his Christian wife to bathe from janabah. Ibn al-Qasim said, from Malik, regarding a Christian woman who is under (married to) a Muslim, and she menstruates and becomes pure: that she is forced to bathe from menstruation so that her husband may have intercourse with her, because the Muslim does not have intercourse with his wife until she becomes pure from menstruation. As for janabah, there is no harm in having intercourse with her while she is junub (in a state of major ritual impurity).

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ : وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ : لَا يُجْبِرُ الرَّجُلُ الْمُسْلِمُ امْرَأَتَهُ النَّصْرَانِيَّةَ عَلَى أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ , وَقَالَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ ، عن مَالِكٍ فِي النَّصْرَانِيَّةِ تَكُونُ تَحْتَ الْمُسْلِمِ ، فَتَحِيضُ فَتَطْهُرُ : أَنَّهَا تُجْبَرُ عَلَى الْغُسْلِ مِنَ الْحَيْضَةِ لِيَطَأَهَا زَوْجُهَا مِنْ قِبَلِ أَنَّ الْمُسْلِمَ لَا يَطَأُ امْرَأَتَهُ حَتَّى تَطْهُرَ مِنَ الْحَيْضِ ، وَأَمَّا الْجَنَابَةُ فَلَا بَأْسَ أَنْ يَطَأَهَا وَهِيَ جُنُبٌ .

hadiths.arabicText: فِي الرَّجُلِ الْجُنُبِ يُصَلِّي وَلَا يَذْكُرُ جَنَابَتَهُ

hadiths.english_translation: I asked Malik about a man who experiences janabah and does not know about it until he goes out to the market and sees the janabah in his garment, and he had prayed before that. He said: He should leave immediately, bathe, wash what is in his garment, and pray that prayer, then go to his need. He said: Malik said regarding one in a state of janabah who leads people in prayer while unaware of his janabah, and he prays with them one, two, or three rak'ahs, then remembers that he is junub. He said: He should leave and appoint someone to lead the people in what remains of the prayer, and the prayer of the people behind him is complete. He said: If he finishes the prayer and does not remember that he is junub until he finishes, then the prayer of those behind him is complete, and he must repeat it alone. If the imam, when he prayed with them, was remembering the janabah, then the prayer of all the people is invalid. He said: Whoever knew of his janabah from among those behind him who follow him, while the imam has forgotten his janabah, his prayer is invalid. He said: If he prayed with the people after remembering the janabah, out of ignorance or embarrassment, he has invalidated the people's prayer. Ibn al-Qasim said: Everyone who prays with people, and something enters upon him that invalidates his prayer, and he continues with them, their prayer is invalidated and they must repeat it when they know. And Umar ibn al-Khattab prayed with the people while he was junub, then he made up the prayer and did not command the people to make it up. Ali said, from Sufyan, from al-Mughirah, from Ibrahim al-Nakha'i, he said: If the imam prays without ablution, he repeats and they do not repeat.

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ : وَسَأَلْتُ مَالِكًا عن الرَّجُلِ تُصِيبُهُ الْجَنَابَةُ ، وَلَا يَعْلَمُ بِذَلِكَ حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ إِلَى السُّوقِ ، فَيَرَى الْجَنَابَةَ فِي ثَوْبِهِ ، وَقَدْ كَانَ صَلَّى قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ ؟ قَالَ : يَنْصَرِفُ مَكَانَهُ فَيَغْتَسِلُ وَيَغْسِلُ مَا فِي ثَوْبِهِ ، وَيُصَلِّي تِلْكَ الصَّلَاةَ وَلْيَذْهَبْ إِلَى حَاجَتِهِ . قَالَ : وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ فِي الْجُنُبِ يُصَلِّي بِالْقَوْمِ وَهُوَ لَا يَعْلَمُ بِجَنَابَتِهِ ، فَيُصَلِّي بِهِمْ رَكْعَةً أَوْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثًا ، ثُمَّ يَذْكُرُ أَنَّهُ جُنُبٌ , قَالَ : يَنْصَرِفُ وَيَسْتَخْلِفُ مَنْ يُصَلِّي بِالْقَوْمِ مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ وَصَلَاةُ الْقَوْمِ خَلْفَهُ تَامَّةٌ , قَالَ : وَإِنْ فَرَغَ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَنَّهُ جُنُبٌ حَتَّى فَرَغَ ، فَصَلَاةُ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ تَامَّةٌ ، وَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُعِيدَ هُوَ وَحْدَهُ , وَإِنْ كَانَ الْإِمَامُ حِينَ صَلَّى بِهِمْ كَانَ ذَاكِرًا لِلْجَنَابَةِ ، فَصَلَاةُ الْقَوْمِ كُلُّهُمْ فَاسِدَةٌ . قَالَ : وَمَنْ عَلِمَ بِجَنَابَتِهِ مِمَّنْ خَلْفَهُ مِمَّنْ يَقْتَدِي بِهِ ، وَالْإِمَامُ نَاسٍ لِجَنَابَتِهِ فَصَلَاتُهُ فَاسِدَةٌ , قَالَ : وَإِنْ كَانَ صَلَّى بِالْقَوْمِ بَعْدَمَا ذَكَرَ الْجَنَابَةَ جَاهِلًا أَوْ مُسْتَحِيًا ، فَقَدْ أَفْسَدَ عَلَى الْقَوْمِ صَلَاتَهُمْ . قَالَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ : وَكُلُّ مَنْ صَلَّى بِقَوْمٍ ، فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ مَا يَنْقُضُ صَلَاتَهُ ، فَتَمَادَى بِهِمْ فَصَلَاتُهُمْ مُنْتَقَضَةٌ وَعَلَيْهِمُ الْإِعَادَةُ مَتَى عَلِمُوا , وَقَدْ صَلَّى عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ بِالنَّاسِ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ ، ثُمَّ قَضَى الصَّلَاةَ وَلَمْ يَأْمُرِ النَّاسَ بِالْقَضَاءِ . قَالَ عَلِيٌّ ، عن سُفْيَانَ ، عن الْمُغِيرَةِ ، عن إِبْرَاهِيمَ النَّخَعِيِّ ، قَالَ   : إِذَا صَلَّى الْإِمَامُ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ أَعَادَ وَلَمْ يُعِيدُوا .

hadiths.arabicText: فِي الثَّوْبِ يُصَلِّي فِيهِ وَفِيهِ النَّجَاسَةُ

hadiths.english_translation: I heard Malik regarding blood that is in a garment, or impurity (danas), and one prays in it, then learns about it after the sun has yellowed (before sunset)? He said: If he does not remember until the sun has yellowed, there is no repetition upon him. He said: Malik made the time for one who prayed while his garment had impurity until the yellowing of the sun, and he distinguished between him and the one who gives salams (completes prayer) before the setting of the sun, and the insane person who regains sanity before the setting of the sun, and the menstruating woman who becomes pure before the setting of the sun - he used to say: The entire day until the sun sets is a time for these. As for one who prayed while his garment had impurity, his time is until the yellowing of the sun - this alone Malik made for him a time until the yellowing of the sun. And the one who prays facing other than the qiblah is like him. I said: What if the impurity was on his body? He said: I heard Malik saying: Impurity on the body and on the garment are the same. And Malik had said: He repeats as long as it is within the time. Rabi'ah and Ibn Shihab said likewise. He said: Malik said: Whoever prays on an impure place, upon him is repetition as long as it is within the time, like one who prayed while his garment had impurity. I said: What if the impurity was only on the place of his forehead, or the place of his palms, or the place of his feet only, or the place of his sitting only? He said: I see repetition upon him as long as it is within the time, even if the impurity was only on the place of the palms alone, or the place of the forehead alone, or the place of the feet, or the place of his sitting alone. He said: Malik said: Whoever has only one garment with him, and has no other, and it has impurity in it. He said: He prays in it, and when he obtains another garment and obtains water and washes it, he repeats as long as it is within the time. When the time passes, there is no repetition upon him. I said: If he has a silk garment and an impure garment, with which of them do you prefer that he prays? He said: He prays in the silk is more beloved to me, and he repeats if he finds other than it as long as it is within the time, and likewise it reached me from Malik that he said. Because the Messenger of Allah ﷺ 'forbade the wearing of silk.'

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ : وَسَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا عن الدَّمِ يَكُونُ فِي الثَّوْبِ أَوِ الدَّنَسِ ، فَيُصَلِّي بِهِ ، ثُمَّ يَعْلَمُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ بَعْدَ اصْفِرَارِ الشَّمْسِ ؟ قَالَ : إِنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ حَتَّى اصْفَرَّتِ الشَّمْسُ ، فَلَا إِعَادَةَ عَلَيْهِ , قَالَ : وَجَعَلَ مَالِكٌ وَقْتَ مَنْ صَلَّى وَفِي ثَوْبِهِ دَنَسٌ إِلَى اصْفِرَارِ الشَّمْسِ ، وَفَرَّقَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الَّذِي يُسَلِّمُ قَبْلَ مَغِيبِ الشَّمْسِ , وَالْمَجْنُونِ يُفِيقُ قَبْلَ مَغِيبِ الشَّمْسِ , وَالْحَائِضِ تَطْهُرُ قَبْلَ مَغِيبِ الشَّمْسِ , كَانَ يَقُولَ : النَّهَارُ كُلُّهُ حَتَّى تَغِيبَ الشَّمْسُ وَقْتٌ لِهَؤُلَاءِ , وَأَمَّا مَنْ صَلَّى وَفِي ثَوْبِهِ دَنَسٌ ، فَوَقْتُهُ إِلَى اصْفِرَارِ الشَّمْسِ هَذَا وَحْدَهُ جَعَلَ لَهُ مَالِكٌ إِلَى اصْفِرَارِ الشَّمْسِ وَقْتًا , وَالَّذِي يُصَلِّي إِلَى غَيْرِ الْقِبْلَةِ مِثْلُهُ .    @ 1 : 82 @   قُلْتُ : فَإِنْ كَانَ الدَّنَسُ فِي جَسَدِهِ ؟ قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا يَقُولُ : الدَّنَسُ فِي الْجَسَدِ وَفِي الثَّوْبِ سَوَاءٌ , وَقَدْ قَالَ مَالِكٌ : يُعِيدُ مَا كَانَ فِي الْوَقْتِ , قَالَ رَبِيعَةُ ، وَابْنُ شِهَابٍ مِثْلَهُ . قَالَ : وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ : مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَى مَوْضِعٍ نَجَسٍ عَلَيْهِ الْإِعَادَةُ مَا دَامَ فِي الْوَقْتِ بِمَنْزِلَةِ مَنْ صَلَّى وَفِي ثَوْبِهِ دَنَسٌ . قُلْتُ : فَإِنْ كَانَتِ النَّجَاسَةُ إِنَّمَا هِيَ فِي مَوْضِعِ جَبْهَتِهِ فَقَطْ ، أَوْ مَوْضِعِ كَفَّيْهِ ، أَوْ مَوْضِعِ قَدَمَيْهِ فَقَطْ ، أَوْ مَوْضِعِ جُلُوسِهِ فَقَطْ ؟ قَالَ : أَرَى عَلَيْهِ الْإِعَادَةَ مَا دَامَ فِي الْوَقْتِ ، وَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُنِ النَّجَاسَةُ إِلَّا فِي مَوْضِعِ الْكَفَّيْنِ وَحْدَهُ ،   أَوْ مَوْضِعِ الْجَبْهَةِ وَحْدَهَا ، أَوْ مَوْضِعِ الْقَدَمَيْنِ ، أَوْ مَوْضِعِ جُلُوسِهِ وَحْدَهُ , قَالَ : وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ : مَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ ثَوْبٌ وَاحِدٌ ، وَلَيْسَ مَعَهُ غَيْرُهُ وَفِيهِ نَجَسٌ , قَالَ : يُصَلِّي بِهِ وَإِذَا أَصَابَ ثَوْبًا غَيْرَهُ ، وَأَصَابَ مَاءً فَغَسَلَهُ أَعَادَ مَا دَامَ فِي الْوَقْتِ , فَإِذَا مَضَى الْوَقْتُ ، فَلَا إِعَادَةَ عَلَيْهِ , قُلْتُ : فَإِنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ ثَوْبٌ حَرِيرٌ ، وَثَوْبٌ نَجِسٍ بِأَيِّهِمَا تُحِبُّ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ ؟ قَالَ : يُصَلِّي بِالْحَرِيرِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ ، وَيُعِيدُ إِنْ وَجَدَ غَيْرَهُ مَا دَامَ فِي الْوَقْتِ ، وَكَذَلِكَ بَلَغَنِي عن مَالِكٍ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ , لِأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " نَهَى عن لِبَاسِ الْحَرِيرِ " .

hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: Regarding praying while experiencing urgency (to relieve oneself).

potential_issues.issue: This is a chapter title without any hadith content
potential_issues.impact: No chain to analyze

Topics: Praying While Needing to Relieve Oneself

hadiths.english_translation: I asked Malik about a man who experiences urgency (to relieve himself)? He said: If something light of that affects him, I see that he should pray. And if something of that affects him that distracts him from his prayer, then he should not pray until he fulfills his need, then performs ablution and prays. I said: If he is affected by nausea or rumbling in his stomach, what is Malik's position on it if it distracts him in his prayer? He said: I do not remember anything from Malik about it, and rumbling according to Malik is like urgency. I said: Do you see that if it hurries him from his prayer, is it something that distracts him? He said: Yes. I said: If he prays in that condition and finishes, do you see repetition upon him? He said: If it distracts him, then it is more beloved to me that he repeats. I said to him: Within the time and after the time? He said: If repetition is upon him, then it is like that - he repeats even if the time has passed. And that has reached me from Malik. Then he said: Umar ibn al-Khattab said: 'None of you should pray while he is pressing between his buttocks.' Yahya ibn Ayyub said, from Ya'qub ibn Mujahid, that al-Qasim ibn Muhammad and Abdullah ibn Muhammad narrated to him, that Aisha narrated to them. She said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: 'None of you should stand for prayer in the presence of food, nor while he is resisting the two filthy things: feces and urine.' And Malik mentioned that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'When one of you feels the need for feces, let him begin with it before the prayer.' And it was mentioned from Ata': If what is with him is something that does not distract him from the prayer, he prays with it. And that Ibn Umar said: I would not care if there was in the side of my garment if I was resisting feces or urine - from the hadith of Ibn Wahb, from al-Suddi, from al-Taymi, from Abdullah. And it was mentioned from Ibn Mas'ud like the statement of Ibn Umar.

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ : وَسَأَلْتُ مَالِكًا عن الرَّجُلِ يُصِيبُهُ الْحَقْنُ ؟ قَالَ : إِذَا أَصَابَهُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْءٌ خَفِيفٌ رَأَيْتُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ , وَإِنْ أَصَابَهُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ مَا يَشْغَلُهُ عن صَلَاتِهِ ، فَلَا يُصَلِّي حَتَّى يَقْضِيَ حَاجَتَهُ ، ثُمَّ يَتَوَضَّأَ وَيُصَلِّيَ . قُلْتُ : فَإِنْ أَصَابَهُ غَيَثَانٌ أَوْ قَرْقَرَةٌ فِي بَطْنِهِ مَا قَوْلُ مَالِكٍ فِيهِ إِذَا كَانَ يَشْغَلُهُ فِي صَلَاتِهِ ؟ قَالَ : لَا أَحْفَظُ مِنْ مَالِكٍ فِيهِ شَيْئًا ، وَالْقَرْقَرَةُ عندَ مَالِكٍ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْحَقْنِ . قُلْتُ : أَرَأَيْتَ إِذَا أَعْجَلَهُ عن صَلَاتِهِ أَهُوَ مِمَّا يَشْغَلُهُ ؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ . قُلْتُ : فَإِنْ صَلَّى عَلَى ذَلِكَ ، وَفَرَغَ أَتَرَى عَلَيْهِ إِعَادَةً ؟ قَالَ : إِذَا شَغَلَهُ فَأَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ أَنْ يُعِيدَ . قُلْتُ لَهُ : فِي الْوَقْتِ وَبَعْدَ الْوَقْتِ ؟ قَالَ : إِذَا كَانَ عَلَيْهِ الْإِعَادَةُ ، فَهُوَ كَذَلِكَ يُعِيدُ ، وَإِنْ خَرَجَ الْوَقْتُ , وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِي ذَلِكَ ، عن مَالِكٍ , ثُمَّ قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ : " لَا يُصَلِّي أَحَدُكُمْ وَهُوَ ضَامٌّ بَيْنَ وَرِكَيْهِ " . قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ ، عن /94 يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ مُجَاهِدٍ /94 ، أَنَّ /26 الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ /26 ، /26 وَعَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ /26 ، حدثاه أَنَّ /93 عَائِشَةَ /93 حَدَّثَتْهُمَا ، قَالَتْ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ : " لَا يَقُومُ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ بِحَضْرَةِ الطَّعَامِ ، وَلَا وَهُوَ يُدَافِعُهُ الْأَخْبَثَانِ : الْغَائِطُ ، وَالْبَوْلُ " , وَذَكَرَ مَالِكٌ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ   وَسَلَّمَ ، قَالَ : " إِذَا وَجَدَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْغَائِطَ ، فَلْيَبْدَأْ بِهِ قَبْلَ الصَّلَاةِ " , وَذَكَرَ عن عَطَاءٍ : إِنْ كَانَ الَّذِي بِهِ شَيْءٌ لَا يَشْغَلُهُ عن الصَّلَاةِ صَلَّى بِهِ , وَإِنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ قَالَ : مَا كُنْتُ أُبَالِي أَنْ يَكُونَ فِي جَانِبِ رِدَائِي إِذَا كُنْتُ مُدَافِعًا لِغَائِطٍ أَوْ لِبَوْلٍ مِنْ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ ، عن السُّدِّيِّ ، عن التَّيْمِيِّ ، عن عَبْدِ اللَّهِ , وَذُكِرَ عن ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ، مثل قَوْلِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ : وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ : لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ يُقِيمَ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى وُضُوءٍ وَاحِدٍ يُصَلِّيَ بِهِ يَوْمَيْنِ ، أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ .

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Ibn Wahb, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ziyad ibn An'am, from Abu Ghutayf al-Hudhali, that Abdullah ibn Umar said to him: 'Verily, my ablution for the morning prayer suffices me for all my prayers as long as I do not break it.' [Second narration:] Ibn Wahb said, from Sufyan ibn Sa'id, from Alqamah ibn Marthad, from Sulayman ibn Buraydah, from his father, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: 'That he prayed on the day of the conquest of Makkah all the prayers with one ablution, and he wiped over his leather socks.' Then Umar said: I saw you do something you did not used to do? He said: 'I did it intentionally, O Umar.'
